text:
elaine (CEO): Quick exec weekly  two small but important updates: a short policy change and launch readiness notes. TL;DR: data-retention policy tweak, Private GA checklist, and topline metrics. Full writeup: https://redwood-internal.link/exec-weekly-2190 :page_with_curl:

mira (Head of Product Ops): Noted. I've pinned the Private GA checklist in the doc and added an item for KMS verification. Please review by EOD Tuesday.

elaine (CEO): mira please own KMS verification. dara and legal-bot 9 verify there's no outstanding compliance blockers for Private GA in EU.
dara (VP Eng): Will run a final infra compliance sweep. ETA Wed 04:00 UTC. We'll include a traffic shadow run for two customers (no SLA until GA).

legal-bot: Flag: Updated data retention policy draft posted. Main change: default retention for non-pay customers reduced from 180d to 90d; enterprises retain configurable retention via contract. Link: https://redwood-internal.link/policy-retention-2190

nina (Finance): Quick metric snapshot for the week: MRR +2.7% w/w, churn stable at 1.1%, cost per 1M tokens served down ~8% after Optimize pilot. Hosting revenue growth driven by mid-market pilots.

elaine (CEO): Good. Sanjay 9 sales impact? any customer pushback on retention defaults?

sanjay (VP Sales): So far only one objection from a pilot who wanted 365d by default. We can handle via contract amendment or opt-in. I'll escalate for the two enterprise pilots.

mira (Head of Product Ops): Private GA checklist highlights: KMS + audit logs validated, privacy review complete, ramp plan for region capacity, runbook and oncall roster templated. Missing items: final SLA page and billing reconciliation test.

elaine (CEO): dara please ensure SLA page matches Dedicated language where applicable. Nina please run billing reconciliation test with finance dev account.

dara (VP Eng): Acknowledged. Also adding an emergency degrade mode: if KV store latency >200ms we flip to stateless-mode for new requests to protect tail latency. Will ship toggle behind runtime flag.

ops-bot: Shadow run scheduled: private-ga-shadow-2customers @ 2026-04-01T09:00Z. Duration: 3h. Observability probes enabled. Auto-notify if error-rate >1% or p99 >350ms.

elaine (CEO): Policy note: retention change aimed to reduce long-tail storage cost while keeping enterprise flexibility. Key ask: product + legal make a short FAQ for Sales by Thursday. Sanjay, mira: please coordinate.

legal-bot: Draft FAQ created: https://redwood-internal.link/faq-retention-2190. Please comment by Wednesday EOD.

nina (Finance): Cost goal for Q2: additional 10% unit-cost reduction through batching + model selection policy. We have runway to invest in a small team to implement extractor heuristics if exec approves.

elaine (CEO): Approve headcount for a 2-FTE short-term Optimize sprint to reach that target. Finance and Product Ops to define success criteria and duration.

mira (Head of Product Ops): I'll draft the sprint charter and KPIs by tomorrow morning.

dara (VP Eng): One more operational ask: oncall burden spike last week due to a hidden dependency in autoscaler. Postmortem in docs with owners assigned. Link: https://redwood-internal.link/pm-autoscaler-2190

elaine (CEO): Thanks. Final asks from me this week:
- mira: finalize KMS verification + FAQ for Sales
- dara: infra sweep + SLA alignment + runtime degrade toggle PR
- nina: billing reconciliation test + sprint KPIs for Optimize headcount
- sanjay: customer comms on retention changes and contract exceptions

sanjay (VP Sales): Will start outreach today.

ops-bot: Shadow run completed: no rollback. Metrics: error spike 0.6%, p99 320ms during brief spike.

elaine (CEO): OK — close loop on listed action items in their respective docs. Appreciate the teams moving fast. We'll include a short GA readiness banner in next week's note. :rocket:
